why.l:vì oán: same slap, reworded: a consort's servant-strike on a rival's servant now names her reason ('bị X tát vì oán Y', jface fxRivSrv2 why); every slap line 645 → 579 (12 seeds × 200 tuần, G1 #7 probe), the old line had no reason after 'tát'
why.l:ngươi: same lines, one reworded (G1 #12 probe, seeds 1–12, 200 tuần, head d2637750 vs LIVE bb8e8ec9): this name-stripped key is every '<name> <verb> ngươi' head; 20 of the head's 33 are the j24 apFriend gift now naming her reason ('X quý ngươi, mang sang tặng …'; LIVE writes 'X mang sang tặng ngươi …' = another key); the rest ('X khen ngươi' 7 + 'X nhìn ngươi' 6 = 13) vs LIVE 11 (6 + 5) is in band
why.l:thị vệ: same report line, more real occasions (G1 #12 probe, seeds 1–12): LIVE's MEN_* nết words are dead (phong lưu / đa tình / tham vọng no longer exist in the pool nết; G1 #8 fixed hasT on the head, LUẬT SỬA CẢ NHÓM), so on LIVE no man ever plans a 'seek' or 'overstay' and only disloyal guards carry letters: men's plans head seek 399 / overstay 110 / letter 691 vs LIVE 0 / 0 / 342; NPC reports to the guards head letter 70 + seek 26 + overstay 11 vs LIVE letter 24 → every 'báo thị vệ' line 102 vs 22. No dice: each report is a woman really at that place (menNpcSee) who saw the man
why.l:chưa quen biết buông lời: the same provoke line, name-masked when she has not met the provoker (j61 k61Mask 'một vị <tước> chưa quen biết'): every 'buông lời khiêu khích' line head 369 vs LIVE 288 (1.28, in band; G1 #12 probe seeds 1–12); only the stranger share moves with whom she has met on the seed path (33 vs 9)
why.c:Nội vụ phủ trả đồ: rare 4-step chain, the same code in both builds (jdemo demoSeize/demoReturn, j14 cold/restore unchanged): lãnh cung → Nội vụ phủ seizes the worn pieces → an amnesty → she stays out ≥ 1 tuần AND the box holds pieces she still qualifies for (rank-0 jewellery) → one card per piece. G1 #11 probes vs LIVE e16e1d6, seeds 1–12: seizures from her 15 vs 18, amnesty releases 50 vs 42 (equal); base +48 'Thái hậu mở lòng từ bi' releases all in ONE seed (10: her Thái hậu ≥ mercyTh 50 for 67 tuần in lãnh cung; on the head seed 10 runs the maid road, her th < 50 in every head seed while in lãnh cung; NPC mercy releases 0 in both builds); returns follow the same releases in both builds (box empty or wd-only pieces = no return). Base run to run 32 / ~37 (rA OUT, rB in band, head 9 both). Noise floor seeds 13–24 (RATES_SEED0=12, both builds): 30 vs 32.7 = in band.
